thread:
Sam: Hey all — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/64321 is ready. It changes routing fallback ordering and tweaks X-Redwood-Auth header ordering. Need runtime perf eyes for latency, eng-infra for eviction behavior, eng-platform for rollout/canary plan, eng-security for header ordering. Target merge Wed EOD. :eyes:
Priya: linking, thanks. Quick Q — is this backwards-compatible for older clients?
Sam: Yes — header ordering only affects how we prefer auth header when both present. Fallback routing adds a new route preference but keeps old route as fallback.
Maya: Sam — can you paste the config diff? Also pinging @Jin from infra for eviction implications.
Sam: ```
- routing:
-  prefer_cache: true
+ routing:
+  prefer_cache: false
+  fallback_priority: [ "region-local", "global" ]
``` 
Sam: Also changed header precedence: prefer X-Redwood-Auth over Authorization when present.
Jin: looking. rough perf risk? I'll run a quick smoke locally.
deploy-bot: CI check: unit tests passed, integration tests failed on kv-eviction test (flaky). see: https://ci.redwood/6789
Maya: @Jin can you confirm whether eviction test failure is related to fallback_priority change?
Jin: Not sure yet. The failing trace points to lease expiry timing, but config bump could influence pathing. I'll dig and report by noon.
Priya: @security-bot can you pls take a quick look at header precedence? We need to ensure no auth bypass.
security-bot: queued audit job; ETA ~3h. Initial check: header precedence is ok but ask Sam to add unit test for both headers present.
Sam: will add unit test and push. Also can we hold merge until infra/LGTMs? Prefer to avoid forced merge if CI flaky.
Maya: +1. If infra confirms it's unrelated and security OK, we can schedule merge Thu morning during low-traffic window.
Jin: quick update — local smoke didn't reproduce failure; infra run reproduces flaky kv-eviction test intermittently. I'll attach logs in PR.
Sam: thanks. adding test now. pinging owners: @runtime-team, @eng-infra, @eng-platform, @eng-security — please ack or raise blockers.
Maya: noted. :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks Sam. I'll review the code and the new test after your push.
Sam: pushed unit test and log link. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/64321/files
Jin: left infra comments. no block but need canary with extended ttl to watch eviction metrics.
Maya: sounds good. scheduling canary Thu 02:00 UTC if no blockers.
security-bot: audit job complete: no auth bypass found. left one nit re: comment clarity.
Sam: resolved comment, thanks. who can +1 for merge plan? need explicit runtime + infra + security + platform.
Priya: +1 runtime
Jin: +1 infra (monitoring canary)
Maya: +1 platform (slot scheduled Thu 02:00 UTC)
security-bot: +1 security
Sam: thanks all — will merge Thu 02:00 UTC after canary pass. Closing thread.
